what: the train CHIPPER: a compact electric corpse woodchipper bolted inside the player train (feed hopper with a flap curtain, guarded rotor housing with an inspection grille, motor + belt guard, control box with stop button and lever, discharge spout + hose, twin collection tanks, welded base frame)
approval: task-specific user generation approval (sha256 b2ffae0f5c83438e69fe84ae52f4361ce5d5269a5eb661558f3fcb1958f09bfa): one woodchipper model and supported processing, up to 100 Meshy credits / 6 generation attempts
route: Codex native image_gen INITIAL design / conditioning image (flat side elevation) -> Meshy T2.5 image-to-3D (smart topology, 2K PBR); the Meshy model keeps its own PBR maps (re-encoded only)

conditioningImage.generator: Codex CLI 0.163.0 built-in image_gen (model id not reported)

meshy.evidence: the exact create arguments are in the fsynced ledger reserve line before the POST; the 15-credit charge is the T2 / T2.5 single-image textured price

orientation.result: Meshy native frame kept (no rotation): +Y up, hopper -X, so the conditioning side elevation is the +Z face

transform: uniform scale to the runtime length, grounded (min y = 0), centred on x / z, baked into the vertices (identity node); no rotation, no geometry simplification (Smart Topology made the approved target count)
convention: metres at runtime size, +Y up, origin at the bottom centre of the base frame; +Z = the front (rotor housing inspection grille, control box face), -X = the feed hopper end, +X = the twin collection tanks

anchorMethod.hopper: top-down height map (5 mm) of the -X 40 % slab: floor = its most populated 1 cm band, rim = the highest band holding >= 4 % of the cells (the end walls + the top rails across the box); inner X = the end walls' inner faces along the centre line z = 0, inner Z = the extent of every cell between them that sees the floor; anchor = the inner rectangle's centre at the rim height
anchorMethod.outlet: section planes x = const every 2.5 mm from x 0.1 m inside the spout lane y 0.2..0.46, z -0.1..0.1 m: the first one cut as a single closed ring <= 0.15 m across (past the rotor housing / flange plates) = the spout root; anchor = the ring centre
anchorMethod.panel: front depth map (5 mm) in x 0.1..0.34, y 0.42..0.68 m: the most common 1 cm depth band = the control box face; anchor = its largest connected patch's centre on the face plane (mean depth)

texturePolicy: Meshy maps kept channel for channel (base colour, packed metallic-roughness, normal), Lanczos downsize + JPEG: base 1024 px q85, metallic-roughness 512 px q85, normal 1024 px q90; no reprojection / retexture / repaint
